boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: to represent, stand for, or serve as a symbol of something; to express something through symbols
ops.cn: 象征；代表；作为某事物的符号，也可指用符号表达

ops.en: relating to technology, especially the development or use of technical methods, systems, processes, or devices
ops.cn: 技术的；科技的；与技术方法、系统、流程或设备的开发和使用有关的

ops.en: contrary to, inconsistent with, or not permitted by the relevant constitution
ops.cn: 违宪的；与相关宪法相冲突或不被其允许的

ops.en: not defined, specified, or clearly determined
ops.cn: 未定义的；未说明的；没有被明确确定的

ops.en: mathematics/computing: having no defined value or meaning in the given context
ops.cn: （数学/计算机）在给定语境中没有定义值或明确含义的

ops.en: not controlled, governed, or subject to official rules, regulation, or regulatory oversight
ops.cn: 未受监管的；不受官方规则、规章或监管机构控制管理的

boundaries.note: Common British noun spelling of the same noun. Existing utilise@o5235 is a distinct verb owner and remains read-only.

ops.en: the act, process, or degree of using something, especially making practical or effective use of a resource or capacity
ops.cn: 利用；使用；对资源、能力等加以实际或有效使用的过程或程度

ops.en: the process of confirming or establishing the validity, accuracy, acceptability, or fitness for purpose of something such as data, a method, or a model
ops.cn: 验证；确认数据、方法、模型等的有效性、准确性、可接受性或是否适合预定用途的过程

ops.en: the quality of being valid, sound, well-founded, or acceptable in a logical, legal, or scientific sense
ops.cn: 有效性；正当性；在逻辑、法律或科学意义上成立、可靠或有根据的性质

ops.en: measurement/research: the degree to which a test, measure, or study actually measures or captures what it is intended to measure
ops.cn: （测量/研究）效度；测试、测量工具或研究在多大程度上真正测量到预期测量对象

ops.en: the process or technique of forming a mental image or making something visible through a visual representation
ops.cn: 可视化；视觉化；在头脑中形成图像或通过视觉表示使信息可见的过程或技术

ops.en: a visual or graphical representation created to make an idea, structure, or information easier to understand
ops.cn: 视觉表示；图形化呈现；为帮助理解概念、结构或信息而制作的视觉图像

ops.en: data visualization: the graphical representation of data to reveal patterns, relationships, or trends
ops.cn: 数据可视化；用图形方式呈现数据以展示模式、关系或趋势
